form.label: Dynamic Correlation
form.description: Start with TWO sources (web app + hypervisor), then add a THIRD live — and watch the same incident line up across all of them, with each tier's error messages.

condition.set: index=berlin_db sourcetype=postgres:log (ERROR OR FATAL) | table _time host _raw | head 25
OR (index=berlin_network ("Connection timed out" OR "Connection refused" OR "No route to host" OR "%LINK" OR "%LINEPROTO" OR down))
index=berlin_network ("Connection timed out" OR "Connection refused" OR "No route to host" OR "%LINK" OR "%LINEPROTO" OR down) | table _time host _raw | head 25
OR (index=berlin_snmp (linkDown OR down OR error OR trap))
index=berlin_snmp (linkDown OR down OR error OR trap) | table _time host _raw | head 25

html.p: The Directory App is a two-tier service — a web app container and a PostgreSQL container — both running on the Proxmox hypervisor. When something breaks, the evidence is scattered across separate logs. Correlation lines them up on time so one screen tells the whole story.

ul.li: Source A — Web app: index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access (every HTTP request; 5xx = trouble).
Source B — Hypervisor: index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api (container / node state).
Source C — add live: pick one above (Database / Network / SNMP). Adding a source = adding one OR (index=…) clause — that is all correlation is.

html.p: Live demo idea: start on 2 sources, then change the dropdown to Database — the DB series and its error panel appear instantly. Break the DB (demo-chaos.sh break-db) and watch Web 5xx, the hypervisor and the DB errors spike at the same minute.

panel.title: Activity timeline — all selected sources (events / min)

search.query: (index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access) OR (index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api)$c_frag$ | eval tier=case(index=="berlin_web","Web app", index=="berlin_proxmox","Hypervisor", index=="berlin_db","Database", index=="berlin_network","Network", index=="berlin_snmp","SNMP", 1==1,"other") | timechart span=1m count by tier

panel.title: ERROR timeline — problems per tier (events / min)

search.query: (index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access status>=500) OR (index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api (status="error" OR status="not_configured"))$c_efrag$ | eval tier=case(index=="berlin_web","Web 5xx", index=="berlin_proxmox","Hypervisor error", index=="berlin_db","DB error", index=="berlin_network","Network error", index=="berlin_snmp","SNMP alert", 1==1,"other") | timechart span=1m count by tier

panel.title: Correlation footprint — events & errors per tier in the window

search.query: (index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access) OR (index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api)$c_frag$ | eval tier=case(index=="berlin_web","Web app", index=="berlin_proxmox","Hypervisor", index=="berlin_db","Database", index=="berlin_network","Network", index=="berlin_snmp","SNMP", 1==1,"other") | eval is_err=case(index=="berlin_web" AND status>=500,1, index=="berlin_proxmox" AND (status=="error" OR status=="not_configured"),1, index=="berlin_db" AND match(_raw,"(?i)ERROR|FATAL"),1, index=="berlin_network" AND match(_raw,"(?i)timed out|refused|no route|%LINK|down"),1, 1==1,0) | stats count as Events, sum(is_err) as Errors, min(_time) as f, max(_time) as l by tier | eval Window=strftime(f,"%H:%M:%S")." – ".strftime(l,"%H:%M:%S") | table tier Events Errors Window | rename tier as Tier | sort - Errors

panel.title: Web app — error messages (HTTP 5xx / failed requests)

search.query: index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access status>=500 | eval message=coalesce(error, action) | table _time src_ip method path status message | sort - _time | head 25
index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api (status="error" OR status="not_configured") | table _time endpoint name status | sort - _time | head 25

panel.title: The SPL behind this — adding a source is adding one clause

html.pre: (index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access) * Source A — web app | OR (index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api) * Source B — hypervisor | OR (index=berlin_db sourcetype=postgres:log) * Source C — add the DB here | eval tier=case(index=="berlin_web","Web app", index=="berlin_proxmox","Hypervisor", index=="berlin_db","Database", 1==1,"other") | timechart span=1m count by tier * one timeline, all tiers
html.p: To add a 4th source you add another OR (index=…) and one case() line — nothing about the technique changes.
